M1.intervals: percentile bootstrap, B = 2,000, seed 20260827, resampling BioProjects; and separately resampling (host, sequence type) lineages
M1.name: crude rate per host

M2.name: rate under one genome per sequence type
M2.rule: the deterministic selection registered in NM-V4C-002

M3.name: directly standardised rates
M3.purpose: to measure how much of the crude gap is family composition rather than within-family difference. This is the caveat quantified, not a second estimate of the effect
M3.rule: apply each host's family-specific rates to the OTHER host's family distribution, over families present in both, and report both directions

M4.name: rate difference and rate ratio
M4.rule: A. baumannii minus the Klebsiella group, and their ratio, with the same two bootstrap clusterings

decision_rule.claim_is_compositional_if: direct standardisation removes more than half the crude gap, in which case the manuscript must say the difference is substantially a difference in which families each host carries, not in how those families sit
decision_rule.claim_supported: the within-chromosome claim is supported if the rate difference keeps its direction with a 95% interval excluding zero under BOTH clusterings AND under the one-genome-per-sequence-type arm
decision_rule.claim_withdrawn_if: the difference loses direction or its interval covers zero under any registered clustering
decision_rule.no_threshold_may_move: these criteria may not be changed after any arm runs
decision_rule.reported_regardless: all four arms, both standardisation directions, and the failed matched-family arms are reported. Removing an analysis because it failed is the omission this manuscript has already been criticised for

estimand.definition: among chromosomal acquired resistance-gene occurrences of a host, the proportion whose own +-10 kb window contains at least one mobile-element marker; that is class B / (class A + class B)

known_limits: a marginal rate cannot separate architecture from composition; that is what M3 measures and why M3 is not optional
the two hosts differ in how much of their resistome is chromosomal at all (86% against 34%), so these rates are computed on different-sized and differently-composed denominators
class B means a marker within 10 kb. It is not evidence that the element mobilises the gene
post_hoc_and_labelled_as_such: this estimand was chosen AFTER seeing that the matched-family arm was unstable. That is a post-hoc change of estimand and is labelled post hoc wherever it appears. What is not post hoc is the direction of the conclusion: the rule below fixes what each outcome requires before any interval is computed.
title: Within-chromosome marker adjacency as a marginal rate, with direct standardisation for gene-family composition
why_this_replaces_the_matched_contrast: the matched-family odds ratio for the within-chromosome endpoint fails the weight-concentration gate G2 registered in NMV4C_FROZEN_DESIGN.json in every variant, and its sign depends on one family. A marginal rate is estimable where the pooled odds ratio is not.
